ZWE.note: The notice is a health information exchange design tender only; no government-wide data exchange platform is stated.
The notice states nothing about an HMIS or EMR, their tiers, digitisation or clinics.

facts.fact: UNDP Zimbabwe published request for proposal UNDP-ZWE-02187 on 13 November 2026 for technical assistance to design the Health Information Exchange architecture, core platform configuration, mediators and secure channels.

systems.platform: core platform with mediators and secure channels

ZWE.note: No government interoperability framework is stated; the notice concerns a health exchange design tender.
The notice states no law, decree or draft on public bodies sharing data.
The notice names no technical standards for government systems.
